001package com.streamconverter;
002
003/**
004 * Indicates invalid input data (classification A in the exception policy): failures that are
005 * resolved by fixing the input, such as parse errors and validation failures.
006 *
007 * <p>This exception is intended for failures caused by the content of the data being processed (for
008 * example, malformed CSV rows, values that fail validation rules, or unparsable fields). The remedy
009 * for such failures is to correct the input data, not the runtime environment.
010 *
011 * <p>Environmental I/O failures must NOT be wrapped in this type; propagate the original {@link
012 * java.io.IOException} instead. Mixing environmental failures into this classification would
013 * obscure the distinction the exception policy relies on between "fix the input" and "fix the
014 * environment" failures.
015 *
016 * <p>See docs/reference/EXCEPTION_POLICY.md for the full exception classification policy.
017 *
018 * <p>Extends {@link StreamProcessingException}, and therefore {@link java.io.IOException}, so that
019 * callers of {@link com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand#execute} can continue to handle all
020 * stream-level failures with a single {@code catch (IOException)} block.
021 *
022 * @deprecated As of Phase 4 (exception policy implementation), use {@link UserInputException}
023 *     instead for input-related failures. {@link InvalidInputDataException} is retained for
024 *     backwards compatibility but all new code should use {@link UserInputException} for input
025 *     validation errors.
026 */
027@Deprecated(since = "Phase 4", forRemoval = true)
028public class InvalidInputDataException extends StreamProcessingException {
029  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
030
031  /**
032   * Constructs a new InvalidInputDataException with the specified detail message.
033   *
034   * @param message the detail message
035   */
036  public InvalidInputDataException(String message) {
037    super(message);
038  }
039
040  /**
041   * Constructs a new InvalidInputDataException with the specified detail message and cause.
042   *
043   * @param message the detail message
044   * @param cause the cause of the exception
045   */
046  public InvalidInputDataException(String message, Throwable cause) {
047    super(message, cause);
048  }
049}
